name: Download Without Integrity Check
attack_scenario: code is fetched and executed with no checksum or signature — a MITM, a compromised CDN, or a yanked/re-pointed upstream substitutes attacker code that runs in the build or on every install with the pipeline's privileges (e.g. the tj-actions and shai-hulud npm incidents)
negative_test_hint: serve an archive whose content does not match the published "SHA-256 checksum" and assert the install aborts rather than executing it

exemplar.compliant:
RUN curl -fsSL -o install.sh https://example.com/install.sh \
 && echo "<pinned-sha256>  install.sh" | sha256sum -c - \
 && sh install.sh
exemplar.explanation: download to a file, verify a pinned checksum (or signature), then execute; use https with pinned refs for dependency sources
